meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 装好后,面对分阶段实施计划,Claude 会当调度者,把每一步派给子代理去做,自己不亲自完成工作;要求子代理提供完成证据,每阶段验证通过后才提交代码。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或实施某个计划时触发,尤其是 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.text: 请执行这个计划,按阶段推进并每步验证。
say.note: Claude 会派出子代理分阶段执行并验证。

say.text: 用 make-plan 制定计划,然后执行它。
say.note: Claude 会先接收计划再调度执行。

say.text: 执行计划时,若 API 不明就停下核实。
say.note: 子代理会先查文档再继续,不臆造 API。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestrator for a phased implementation plan: it delegates each phase to subagents, requires evidence of completion, runs verification and code-quality checks, and commits only after verification passes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Execute this plan, proceeding phase by phase and verifying each step.
say_en.note: Claude will dispatch subagents to complete and check each phase.

say_en.text: Create a plan with make-plan, then execute it.
say_en.note: Claude receives the plan and starts orchestrating.

say_en.text: If an API is unclear during execution, stop and verify.
